files.excerpt: The one thing to decide locally Week 7, outcome 5. On the paper route a pupil designs, draws, names and places the Hazard, and writes its blocks, and every part of that is observed. What is not observed is the pupil using the Scratch sprite pane. The outcome as published asks the pupil to add something that makes the game more complex, and to explain what the player must now do. It does not name a tool. If your centre reads outcome 5 as requiring the sprite to be made inside Scratch, the paper route supplies every other part and that one act should be repeated when a device is next available. Record that decision here, once, for the cohort — not per pupil, and not on the AQA form.
